integrity.computational_check: Exact mod-two chain calculations for \(4\le n\le8\) reproduce the predicted Betti ranks.
critical_steps: Decompose \(\mathcal N(R_n)=X\cup Y\) from the \(2n\) vertex neighborhoods.
Identify \(X\cap Y\) with the crown graph \(K_{n,n}-M\), of cycle rank \(n^2-3n+1\).
Use simple connectivity for \(n\ge4\) and the homotopy-pushout formula for two null inclusions.
integrity.domain: Lovász neighborhood complexes of \(R_n=L(K_{2,n})\cong K_2\square K_n\) for integers \(n\ge4\).

scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated only for \(n\ge4\); the \(n=3\) case is excluded because the proof's null-homotopy step changes.
The result is an ordinary homotopy classification and does not assert a global simplicial collapse of \(\mathcal N(R_n)\).
Search-based noncoverage does not rule out an older equivalent formulation under different terminology.
title: Neighborhood complexes of two-row rook graphs split into two spheres and a crown suspension
